correctness.rationale: For q>=2, Hanner's inequality gives sharp q-power upper bounds for both the weighted pair and the unweighted pair. The sharp two-number l_q-to-l_2 comparison converts them to squared-norm bounds. The explicit two-coordinate Hanner pair attains both simultaneously, so the displayed formula is an exact supremum. The q=4, lambda=1/4 checkpoint also yields an exact contradiction to the larger printed formula. No finite experiment is used to establish the universal claim.
